text:
ana-peopleops: Need expedited comp-band exception for candidate Priya Kapoor. Manager requests base $160k (band max $150k) + $10k sign-on split; start 2026-04-06 due to visa timing. Can we fast-track?

maria-hiringmgr: Top pick; project needs ramp. Manager ok with 160k + sign-on 6k/4k.

sam-recruiter: H1B transfer clears 2026-04-05 per counsel, so 04-06 start feasible. Candidate remote in India initially. Also asked about benefits effective date.

dalia-hrbp: Benefits standard: 1st of month after 30 days. With 04-06 start, benefits effective 2026-06-01. We can request frontloaded coverage with VP People sign-off.

tony-finance: Any base over band needs comp committee + CFO sign-off. Sign-on ok to approve faster. Send market comps + manager note.

ana-peopleops: Offer summary: Candidate Priya Kapoor; Base 160000; Sign-on 10000 (6k/4k); Start 2026-04-06; Remote (India) -> relocate ~6mo; Rationale: strong market comp and skill fit. Routing: comp-committee -> VP People (Dalia) -> CFO (Tony) -> People Ops.

offer-bot: HR ticket HR-4591 created with expedited flag. SLA ~3 business days.

dalia-hrbp: Marked expedited for benefits/sign-on. Uplift still requires committee. Please email comp-committee@redwood.com with docs.

maria-hiringmgr: Will add manager note + comps. Sam, update offer letter template with split sign-on and benefits note.

sam-recruiter: Draft uploaded to gdrive/Offers/Priya_Kapoor_Draft_v1; CC'ing Legal. If committee not done by 2026-04-02, fallback = band max $150k + sign-on $15k (manager ok).

maria-hiringmgr: Thanks all, I will monitor and jump in on the committee thread if needed.
thread_summary: Expedited routing for comp-band uplift and start-date coordination for Priya Kapoor; discussion of numbers, benefits timing, visa start, routing, and a manager-approved fallback offer.
